title: AirPlay playback reliability improvements (detection, recovery, buffering, UI messaging)

requirements.summary: Fix AirPlay availability/connection detection using Safari event payload and keep connected state synced with the media element’s wireless flag.
acceptanceCriteria: In Safari on an Apple device, the AirPlay button is disabled when AirPlay is not available and enabled when it is available.
When disconnecting from an AirPlay device, the UI reflects the disconnected state within 1 second without requiring a page reload.
No console errors are thrown from the AirPlay hook during connect/disconnect cycles.

file_operations.description: Extend Safari AirPlay typings to represent the `webkitplaybacktargetavailabilitychanged` event payload (e.g., availability values) and ensure the wireless-change event is typed to avoid unsafe casts and runtime console errors.

Update AirPlay detection: set `isAvailable` based on the `webkitplaybacktargetavailabilitychanged` event payload (true/false, not always true), and synchronize `isConnected` with `webkitCurrentPlaybackTargetIsWireless` on initial load and whenever it changes; ensure listeners are resilient and do not throw during rapid connect/disconnect cycles.

requirements.summary: Automatically recover playback on AirPlay route changes by reloading the current source and resuming when the user was playing, preserving track and approximate position when possible.
acceptanceCriteria: If a user is actively playing and then connects to an AirPlay device, the audio begins playing through the AirPlay device within 5 seconds without manual refresh.
If a user is actively playing and then disconnects from AirPlay, the audio resumes locally within 5 seconds without manual refresh.
Play/pause state in the UI remains consistent with actual playback state after route changes.

file_operations.description: Create a focused hook that observes AirPlay connection state changes and coordinates a safe playback recovery attempt (capture current track URL + approximate time, reload media, attempt resume only if previously playing, guard against overlapping recovery attempts).

Wire AirPlay route-change recovery into the main player: use the new recovery hook with the existing `audioRef`, current track source, `isPlaying` intent, and `savedPosition` so connect/disconnect triggers a reload+resume flow while keeping UI play/pause consistent.
Wire the same AirPlay route-change recovery behavior into the embedded player so connect/disconnect triggers reload+resume with best-effort position preservation without requiring a refresh.

requirements.summary: Reduce AirPlay buffering stalls with an AirPlay-specific buffering/recovery strategy while keeping non-AirPlay playback behavior unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: With AirPlay connected, the player does not remain in a continuous buffering state for more than 10 seconds without attempting a recovery action (reload/resume) during normal network conditions.
With AirPlay not connected, playback behavior is unchanged (no new buffering regressions in the existing stream stability indicator behavior).

file_operations.description: Introduce a small utility to encapsulate AirPlay-connected buffering heuristics (e.g., adjusted buffer-ahead thresholds and a capped, quicker recovery cadence for repeated `waiting` / low-buffer conditions) without altering non-AirPlay defaults.

Apply the AirPlay-specific buffering/retry strategy only when `airPlay.isConnected` is true: adjust buffering detection thresholds and add a timed recovery attempt when stuck buffering, while preserving the existing non-AirPlay behavior and StreamStabilityIndicator semantics.

Apply the same AirPlay-only buffering strategy in the embedded player: detect prolonged buffering under AirPlay and trigger a bounded recovery (reload/resume), leaving non-AirPlay buffering logic unchanged.

requirements.summary: Show clear English messaging when AirPlay is connected but audio isn’t playing successfully, with a one-click Retry/Reconnect action.
acceptanceCriteria: When AirPlay is connected and the app detects prolonged buffering/retry failures, the UI displays an actionable message in English describing the issue.
Clicking the retry/reconnect action triggers a playback recovery attempt (and if appropriate, opens the AirPlay picker) without crashing the app.

file_operations.description: Create a small player-UI alert component that renders English status text when AirPlay is connected but playback appears stuck (e.g., prolonged buffering / repeated recovery failures) and provides a single-button action like “Retry AirPlay” that calls a supplied retry handler (and can optionally invoke the AirPlay picker).

Add AirPlay playback messaging to the player UI: detect prolonged buffering / repeated failures specifically while `airPlay.isConnected`, render `AirPlayPlaybackAlert`, and wire its action to trigger a recovery attempt and (when appropriate) call `airPlay.showPicker()`.

Add the same AirPlay playback messaging and one-click retry behavior to the embedded player UI, reusing `AirPlayPlaybackAlert` and wiring it to the embedded player’s recovery handler plus optional `airPlay.showPicker()`.
